---
name: New rule proposal
about: Propose a rule for the catalog
title: "[Rule] <pillar>: <short title>"
labels: rule-proposal
---

**Pillar**
model / dax / performance / governance / visual-design / storytelling / interaction / accessibility / mobile

**Problem a reader or maintainer would hit**
Who is affected and how (wrong number, unreadable, slow, hard to maintain...).

**Check type**
- [ ] D: decidable from files (describe exactly what to look for in PBIR / TMDL)
- [ ] J: needs judgement (describe the evidence the agent should cite)
- [ ] R: needs runtime or Service data

**Proposed severity and why**
Use the rubric in SKILL.md.

**Source**
Link to Microsoft Learn, WCAG or another primary source.

**Known false-positive cases**
When would the check misfire, and how could the scanner or the agent tell?

**Synthetic example**
Minimal snippet with invented names that shows the problem (and one that shows the fixed state).
